characterization_methods: Auger Electron Spectroscopy-Reflective Electron Energy-Loss Spectroscopy (AES-REELS)
evidence: The chemical bonding states of HfO2 and HfOxNy were examined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) of the Hf 4f and N 1s peaks. The valence band spectra of HfO2 and HfOxNy were examined by XPS to understand the change in valence band offset (VBO) by the presence of nitrogen. The bandgap energy was estimated from the intersection of a straight line originating from the background level with a linear fit to the onset of the loss signal spectrum. The leakage current–voltage curves and capacitance–voltage (C-V) curves of HfO2 and HfOxNy were measured. The interface states generated during the stress were examined using a charge pumping method at 500 kHz. The Vth was extracted from the linear drain current–gate voltage (Id-Vg) curves using a constant drain current method.
